items.title: 16.4 First aid in the laboratory (lab mein first aid) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 16.4 with Table 16.1 and Quick Check 16.1, printed pages 339-340.

blocks.text: Har lab mein first aid box hona zaroori hai. Aam accidents (hadse) aur un ka first aid ilaj neeche Table 16.1 mein hai.

blocks.caption: Table 16.1 Accidents and their first aid treatment (hadse aur un ka ilaj)
rows: 1 Kat (cuts)
Mamooli kat
Sheeshe ka tukra ho to nikalein; rui (cotton) se thori methylated spirit ya tincture iodine lagayein. Dono disinfectant (jaraseem maarne wale) hain.
Gehra kat
Khoon rokne ke liye kat par taqreeban 10 minute pressure (dabao) rakhein. Doctor ko dikhayein.
2 Aankh ki chot
Aankh mein acid
Pehle pani se achhi tarah dhoyein, phir 1% sodium bicarbonate solution se.
Aankh mein alkali
Pani se dhoyein, phir 1% boric acid solution se.
Aankh mein koi particle (zarra)
Aankh na malein. Narm roomal se particle dhyan se nikalein, phir pani se dhoyein.
Aankh mein dard (soreness)
Aankh mein olive oil (zaitoon ke tel) ka ek qatra dalein aur kuch der aankh band rakhein.
3 Jalna (burns)
Dry heat se jalna (shola, garam cheez)
Burnol ya sarson ka tel lagayein.
Acid se jalna
Thande (ice cold) pani se khoob dhoyein, phir saturated sodium bicarbonate solution se, phir dobara pani se.
Alkali se jalna
Pani se khoob dhoyein, phir 1% acetic acid solution se, phir pani se; skin sukha kar burnol lagayein.
Bromine se jalna
2% ammonia solution se achhi tarah dhoyein aur glycerin lagayein; kuch der baad glycerin saaf kar ke burnol lagayein.
Blisters (chhale) wala jalna
kitab mein alag ilaj nahi diya gaya
4 Zehar (poisons)
Zehar nigal liya
Foran thook dein, baar baar pani se kulli karein.
Acid nigal liya
Bohat sa pani, ya lime water, ya milk of magnesia piyein.
Caustic alkali nigal liya
Bohat sa pani piyein; lemon ya orange juice ka ek glass piyein.
Heavy metal ka salt nigal liya
Doodh ya ande ki safedi lein.
5 Aag (fire)
i) Kapron ko aag lag jaye
Bhaagein nahi. Blanket (kambal) ya dry sooti kapre mein lipat jayein. Farsh par let jayein.
ii) Inflammable (aag pakarne wale) liquid ke beaker ko aag lage
Beaker ko duster ya geele kapre se dhak dein. Is se oxygen ki supply kat jati hai.
iii) Spirit ya tel ko aag lage
Ret aur sodium bicarbonate ka mixture dalein. Pani na dalein; pani aag ko aur phailata hai.
iv) Bijli ke parts ko aag lage
Foran bijli ki supply band karein aur ret dalein. Aisi aag par pani na dalein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki table mein jalne ki paanch types hain magar ilaj sirf chaar diye gaye hain, is liye line se line milane par treatment ghalat jagah lagta hai. Upar ki table mein sahi joda gaya hai: acid ke jalne ko halki base (sodium bicarbonate) se aur alkali ke jalne ko halke acid (1% acetic acid) se neutralize kiya jata hai; 2% ammonia aur glycerin bromine ke jalne ka ilaj hai. Chhale wale jalne ka alag ilaj kitab mein nahi.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Acid ko halki base aur base ko halka acid neutralize karta hai. Isi liye aankh mein acid ho to sodium bicarbonate (base) aur alkali ho to boric acid istemal hota hai. Bijli ya tel ki aag par pani kabhi na dalein: pani bijli ka current le jata hai aur tel pani par tair kar aag phaila deta hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Lab ke hazards ki aam types batayein.
blocks.explanation: Teen types: physical hazards (phisalna, girna, toote sheeshe se kat), chemical hazards (har chemical ke apne khatre) aur biological hazards (allergens, janwaron se lagne wali bimariyan, viral bimariyan).

blocks.prompt: b) Chemical waste kaise thikane lagaya jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Dabbe ya sewer mein nahi. Proper containers mein rakhein, type, date aur jagah ka label lagayein, aur allocated site bhejein jahan neutralization, precipitation, ion exchange, oxidation ya reduction se treat hota hai (EPA rules).

blocks.prompt: c) Lab mein H₂SO₄ se jalne ka ilaj kaise hota hai?
blocks.explanation: H₂SO₄ acid hai. Jagah ko thande pani se khoob dhoyein, phir saturated sodium bicarbonate solution se (yeh halki base acid ko neutralize karti hai), aur phir dobara pani se.

blocks.prompt: d) Jalne ki different types kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Table 16.1 ke mutabiq: dry heat (shola ya garam cheez) se jalna, chhale wala jalna, acid se jalna, alkali se jalna aur bromine se jalna.

items: Kat: disinfectant (methylated spirit, tincture iodine); gehre kat par 10 minute dabao aur doctor.
Aankh: acid par pani phir 1% NaHCO₃; alkali par pani phir 1% boric acid; particle ho to malein nahi.
Jalna: dry heat par burnol; acid par pani, NaHCO₃, pani; alkali par pani, 1% acetic acid, pani, burnol; bromine par 2% ammonia, glycerin, burnol.
Zehar aur aag: thookein aur kulli; tel ya bijli ki aag par pani nahi, ret dalein.
